Backend Engineer - Full remote - Exampleland


A client of Meridian Analytics based in Exampleland is hiring a number of Backend Engineers to design, build and operate their core services.


This is a hands-on engineering role, focused on turning ideas into fast prototypes and then scaling them into production-ready services.


What you'll be doing:

  • Designing and building resilient backend services
  • Implementing high-performance APIs that power the platform at scale
  • Improving service performance, responsiveness and reliability
  • Collaborating with Product to deliver fast prototypes and iterate quickly
  • Deploying services into production on the Kubernetes ecosystem
  • Making pragmatic technical trade-offs and explaining them clearly


Tech environment:

  • Python / Go
  • Kubernetes (CI/CD, backend services)
  • Event-driven architectures
  • REST and gRPC APIs
  • Scalable backend and cloud deployments


What we're looking for:

  • Strong experience as a Backend Engineer
  • Proven work with distributed systems at scale
  • Solid API development experience
  • Comfortable operating services in production
  • Able to explain design decisions to technical and non-technical colleagues
  • Someone who can deliver fast and think long-term


Location : Fully remote (Exampleland)

Duration : 6-month rolling contract

Headcount : 3

Rate : 300 - 350 per day
